Yes, that feels natural to me. Clicking the little pencil and having the title and description turn right into editable boxes — with the card staying exactly where it is — matches how I'd expect it to work. I'm not yanked off to some other screen; I just fix the words in place and save. That's comfortable and I'd be happy with it.

I'm glad you're comparing it against a couple of other looks before deciding — I'll keep an open mind when I see those — but if you asked me right now, editing directly in the card is the one that feels most like "just tidying up what's in front of me."
